correctness.rationale: Each matched pair has one of nine left/right colors. Clipping counts of each type at 2 preserves all excitation thresholds because the deleted matched edge removes at most one excited neighbor. The nine-trit factor on 3^9 states is exact at any n; recurrent occupied-type maps are bijective, and permutation order around each signature cycle recovers microscopic period and exact first-entry time. Independent enumeration found 19683 signatures, 4394 recurrent signature cycles, max transient 6 with ten six-step signatures, period-6 rare signatures 50 and period-10 rare signatures 6; singleton support forces n=3,5. Labelled orbit/basin counts follow by 3! and 5! lifts, and a repeatable five-pair coloured-state census in the package checks the 720 GH/CCA basin identity. Full microscopic n≤6 verifier was inspected but not independently rerun for all 597870 configurations; no false claim of its independent execution. Exact finite-factor exhaustion plus lifting lemma, not just small-n data, supports all n.
